content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the OUAT Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for OUAT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for OUAT Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Faculty posts at OUAT is scheduled for 06 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Guest Faculty positions at OUAT?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in the respective subject with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent CGPA, along with a good academic record.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Guest Faculty posts is 64 years, as of 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 1200/- per class, with a maximum monthly earning of Rs. 60,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Guest Faculty positions at OUAT.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for OUAT Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation provided?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation details, so candidates should refer to it for specific information.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the OUAT office in Chiplima, Odisha (PIN: 768025).
